spacing_and_layout.bento_strategy: MODE B - High Density Engineering Grid with tactical 1px borders, subtle status top accents, and monospace headers.

motion_and_interactions.motion_library: framer-motion for tab switching, evidence ladder expansion, live test execution stream, and dialog drawers
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: pulsing status dots for live telemetry, active filter highlight, copy-to-clipboard status feedback, live test status state transitions

key_sections.name: Landing Hero & Status Command Strip
key_sections.requirements: Communicates title KETCHUM SYSTEM-OF-SYSTEMS / Human-Governed Intelligence Infrastructure. Live status indicators: SYSTEM STATUS → LIVE, EVIDENCE → E0–E5, AUTHORITY → HUMAN CONTROLLED, and primary button [ RUN TEST ]. Displays invariant marquee immediately underneath.

key_sections.name: Subsystem Architecture Map
key_sections.requirements: Interactive overview of 8 core subsystems: KCN (Cognitive Network), MANIFEX (Engineering OS), KSI (Human Authority), TEVV (Test/Evaluation), Evidence & Provenance, Connectors, Deployment, Security Governance. Clickable nodes with data flows.

key_sections.name: Filterable System Registry
key_sections.requirements: Explorer with status filter (IMPLEMENTED, INTEGRATION_REQUIRED, TEST_REQUIRED, VERIFICATION_REQUIRED, QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED, NOT_MEASURED, BLOCKED). Clicking a component opens detail drawer with explicit fields: [SOURCE_REPOSITORY], [COMMIT_HASH], [API_ENDPOINT], [EVIDENCE_RECORD].

key_sections.name: Live Backend Test Runner
key_sections.requirements: Real execution suite invoking FastAPI `/api/test/run` endpoints. Returns real state machine outcomes: UNAVAILABLE, NOT_CONFIGURED, NOT_MEASURED, BLOCKED, or SUCCESS with timing and response payloads.

key_sections.name: Evidence Explorer (E0–E5 Ladder)
key_sections.requirements: Displays E0 (Unmeasured/Assertion) through E5 (Formal Mathematical Proof & Audit) ladder. NOT_MEASURED is a first-class citizen with no fake claims. Includes strict upgrade rule documentation.

key_sections.name: Human Governance Authority Model (H0–H3)
key_sections.requirements: Explains H0 (Autonomous sandbox) to H3 (Immutable Human Sign-off required). Interactive delegation, authorization check, and revocation audit trail visualizer.

key_sections.name: TEVV Pipeline & Telemetry
key_sections.requirements: Test, Evaluation, Verification & Validation pipeline visualization showing automated suite stages, gate checks, and pass/fail thresholds.

key_sections.name: System Spec Documentation Reader
key_sections.requirements: Fetches and renders real technical markdown specification documents served by FastAPI backend (`/api/docs/{doc_id}`).

instructions_to_main_agent.testing_requirement: CRITICAL: Add data-testid to every button, input, navigation tab, filter badge, status card, modal close button, and key metric block. Use kebab-case e.g. data-testid='hero-run-test-btn', data-testid='registry-filter-implemented', data-testid='component-card-kcn-core'.
instructions_to_main_agent.backend_integration: Implement FastAPI backend endpoints in `/app/backend/server.py` for `/api/system/registry`, `/api/test/run`, `/api/evidence`, `/api/authority`, `/api/docs` and serve real JSON data with explicit status states.
instructions_to_main_agent.frontend_components: Use custom Tailwind structure for page layout and Shadcn components (Dialog, Drawer, Select, Tabs, Badge, Command, Table, Accordion, Tooltip) heavily styled to match the dark obsidian engineering aesthetic.
instructions_to_main_agent.anti_slop_rule: Do not add cheesy sci-fi hacker rain or bright pink/neon glow effects. Maintain high-density engineering rigor, clean monospace callouts, precise borders, clear status badges, and inspectable evidence objects.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Always use modern dark engineering control center button styles with status indicators.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 for icons. Use lucide-react engineering icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, status transitions, clean entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs to give breathing room.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
